# NART Automated Reports and Extracts

> **⚠️ AUTOMATED DIRECTORY — PLEASE DO NOT ADD, DELETE OR MODIFY FILES**

This directory contains reports and data extracts uploaded automatically from Business Objects reporting and ETL systems.

Files are transferred using [rclone](https://rclone.org/) as part of an automated reporting process. This includes:

* Reports scheduled to local filesystem in BI Launchpad.
* Extracts generated by Business Objects Data Services.

The mapping of reports and extracts to sharepoint sites, and frequency of uploads, is managed by NART.

## Important

* **Do not manually add, delete or modify files** in this directory or any of its subdirectories.
* Files are **automatically deleted after a 30 day retention period**.
* Files may be replaced or overwritten by subsequent automated uploads.

If you need to retain a report or extract beyond the 30-day retention period, please copy it to another directory.
This can be automated using tools such as Power Automate.

---

* **Managed by:** NART
* **Source:** Business Objects Reporting and ETL Systems hosted in Modernisation Platform
* **Transfer Mechanism:** rclone
* **Retention Period:** 30 days
